newsitem.title: KENYA: Sugar from Sudan due at Kenya port.
newsitem.headline: Sugar from Sudan due at Kenya port.

text.p: A consignment of 2,012 tonnes of (white mill) sugar is due at the Kenyan port of Mombasa from Sudan, shipping documents showed on Saturday.
It was not immediately possible to establish who imported the sugar or whether it was tendered for on the world market.
Kenya last imported sugar in June -- 20,000 tonnes.
Kenya's sugar consumption is estimated at around 560,000 tonnes against production of around 368,000 tonnes in 1995 which is forecast to rise to 420,000 tonnes in 1996.
The shipping report issued by the Kenya Ports Authority (KPA) said the sugar shipped from Port Sudan would arrive at Mombasa port on September 30 on board MV Winoo Pioneer.
